problem: Tell me all of the candidates for Dublin South-West in the most recent Irish General Election, as of Jan 2024, who received 5% or less of the total "First Preference" vote, excluding candidates who ran as Independents with no political party.
answer: Charlie O'Connor (5.0%, Fianna Fáil), Deirdre O'Donovan (4.9%, Fianna Fáil), Ellen O'Malley Dunlop (4.6%, Fine Gael), Carly Bailey (4.09%, Social Democrats), Sandra Fay (2.45%, Socialist Party), Anne Marie Condren (1.31%, Renua), Philip Dwyer (0.75%, National Party)
